Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Tajdid's text:
"For the remainder of the game, the Blood Curse no longer
prevents Assamites from committing diablerie. Only one Tajdid can be
played in a game."

Since the "Blood Curse" is now a per-vampire effect, and not clan-based,
how does this card work now?  Does it only affect blood-cursed vampires
while they are Assamites?

i.e. I control Qadir ul-Ghani and I play Tajdid.
Qadir may diablerize.

Qadir takes an action to become a Malkavian.
Can Qadir still diablerize?
